ticker_news.title: 2 Top Artificial Intelligence Stocks to Buy Right Now
ticker_news.description: The article highlights two AI stocks with strong potential: SoundHound AI and Nvidia. SoundHound shows promising growth in voice AI technology, while Nvidia remains a critical player in AI chip manufacturing, demonstrating impressive market performance and strategic positioning.
ticker_news.author: Jake Lerch

ticker_news.title: AMD's Earnings Miss Doesn't Matter: This Is Much More Important
ticker_news.description: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is showing promising growth in AI chip development, with seven of the top 10 AI companies using its Instinct chips. Despite not beating quarterly earnings expectations, the company's long-term potential and upcoming MI400 chips position it as an attractive investment.
ticker_news.author: David Jagielski
